original.statement: The cilium_api_limiter_processed_requests_total metric gains a new label return_code carrying the HTTP code of the request.

decision.reason: [ev-af23565ba695] is listed under "Changed Metrics". It says the Prometheus metric `cilium_api_limiter_processed_requests_total` now has a `return_code` label. That makes the subject a metric name. It is not a key of a configuration file or ConfigMap, so the config-key subject misreads the evidence. None of the defined subject families covers a metric's label set, so no correct assertion can be built from this evidence. P2 flagged the same gap.
